name: dsh-lattice-memory
description: Lattice — cross-project, version-aware project memory for DeepSeek Harness. One shared memory library: entries are Markdown files tagged with project dimensions (versions, loaders, platforms, branches). First-run setup picks the library folder; M1 retrieval (BM25 + CJK bigrams + dimension filtering), M2 resident injection + matrix/gaps, M3 write loop (record/verify/jaccard dedupe/secret scan/lint), M4 generality (projects.json workspace overrides + entry cache), M5 export/import (JSON, SKILL.md, AGENTS.md) plus a settings panel, M6 semi-automatic capture (tool failure -> retry success candidates), and M7 automatic capture (human corrections via session/event + turn-end failure chains) ship in this version.
